description: The HR-90 RTO is the Registering Authority (Motor Vehicles) located in the Uchana subdivision of Jind district, Haryana. It is managed by the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) and handles vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and other transport-related services for the region.
address: Office of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM), Uchana, District Jind, Haryana
